title: Roof design.
officialText:
Roofs shall be designed for the maximum possible depth of water that will pond thereon as determined by the
relative levels of roof deck and overflow weirs, scuppers, edges or serviceable drains in combination with the deflected stru ctural
elements. In determining the maximum possible depth of water, all primary roof drains shall be assumed to be blocked.
